blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine National Police (PNP) chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. urged fugitives to surrender to authorities instead of “playing hide-and-seek” after former Sultan Kudarat Rep. Arnulfo Go turned himself in. Go, who was charged with malversation of public funds and corruption, surrendered to the police in General Santos City on Sunday, Nov. 8. Nartatez welcomed Go’s decision and urged other wanted individuals, including former and incumbent public officials, to follow suit.
